content_sections.heading: OAV Mayurbhanj Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 5 vacancies are available - 1 for Warden, 1 for Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper, 1 for Head Cook and 2 for Assistant Cook.

content_sections.heading: OAV Mayurbhanj Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Warden: B.A. / B.Sc. from any recognized university. At least two years in hostel management. Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper: Must have passed HSC Examination from recognized board. Head Cook: Preference & due weightage will be given to individuals trained in cookery. Assistant Cook: Preference & due weightage will be given to individuals trained in cookery.

content_sections.text: Warden: Minimum age 30 years, Maximum age 60 years. Retired Teachers can apply up to 62 years. Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper: Minimum age 21 years, Maximum age 32 years. content_sections.heading: OAV Mayurbhanj Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Preference will be given to local candidates. If candidates are not available in that locality, then block will be taken as a unit. If still candidates are not available, then the candidates from nearby blocks may be selected. No candidates outside of the district should be recruited.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for OAV Mayurbhanj Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https:/ / oav.edu.in/ oav/ home/ OAVLAS. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the OAV Mayurbhanj Support Staff recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive applications for the OAV Mayurbhanj Support Staff recruitment is 12th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Support Staff posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for Support Staff posts, including Warden, Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper, Head Cook, and Assistant Cook positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper post is passing the HSC Examination from a recognized board.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Warden post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Warden post is between 30 to 60 years. Retired teachers are eligible to apply up to 62 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via Speed Post or Registered Post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Assistant Cook position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Assistant Cook position is Rs 6,750/- per month, which includes the EPF share of both the employee and employer.

faq.question: Q7. Does OAV Mayurbhanj give preference to local candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to local candidates. If suitable candidates are not found locally, the recruitment process will extend to the block level and then to nearby blocks.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website to download the application form?
faq.answer: The official website to download the application form is https://oav.edu.in/oav/home/OAVLAS.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any specific qualifications for the Head Cook and Assistant Cook posts?
faq.answer: While specific educational qualifications are not detailed, preference and due weightage will be given to individuals trained in cookery for both Head Cook and Assistant Cook positions.

faq.question: Q10. What documents need to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates with the application form.
